options.text: Identify and extract a 2D right-angled triangle from the 3D shape

A square-based pyramid has base side $10$ cm and vertical height $12$ cm. What is the distance from the apex to the midpoint of a base edge?
questions.explanation: The midpoint of a base edge is $5$ cm from the centre. Slant height $= \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13$ cm. Note options (a) and (b) are the same value.

questions.stem: To find the angle between a line and a plane, you need to find the angle between the line and:

options.text: The longest edge of the plane

questions.explanation: The angle between a line and a plane is the angle between the line and its projection onto the plane.

questions.stem: A room is $6$ m long, $4$ m wide, and $3$ m high. What is the straight-line distance from one bottom corner to the diagonally opposite top corner? (1 d.p.)
questions.explanation: $d = \sqrt{6^2 + 4^2 + 3^2} = \sqrt{36 + 16 + 9} = \sqrt{61} \approx 7.8$ m. Note options (a) and (c) are the same value.
